# Demo data

**Everything in this folder is synthetic.** These files are generated by
[`scripts/generate-demo-data.js`](../../scripts/generate-demo-data.js) and contain
no real people, devices, vendors, or financial records.

The application was originally built against real operational spreadsheets during
a workplace practicum. Those files are **not** in this repository. The CSVs here
are stand-ins with the same column schema, so the app can be run and tested
without touching genuine data.

## Regenerating

```bash
node scripts/generate-demo-data.js
```

The generator is seeded, so the output is byte-for-byte reproducible. It has no
network access and no dependencies outside the Node standard library.

## Files

| File | Rows | Stands in for |
| :--- | ---: | :--- |
| `demo-asset-master-tracker.csv` | 600 | Asset master register |
| `demo-itsm-task-assignments.csv` | 2500 | ITSM task / assignment queue |
| `demo-new-hire-attendance.csv` | 60 | New-starter onboarding sheet |
| `demo-test-device-pool.csv` | 90 | Shared test-device pool |

## How to tell it is fake

Each field uses a reserved or self-evident placeholder convention:

| Field | Convention | Why |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Employee names | `Doe`, `Smith`, `Sample`, `Placeholder` | Reserved example names |
| Email addresses | `*@example.com` | RFC 2606 reserved domain |
| Phone numbers | `+63 900 000 xxxx` | Placeholder number block |
| MAC addresses | `02:00:00:xx:xx:xx` | Locally administered OUI, never assigned to a vendor |
| IMEI numbers | `350000xx…` | TAC block not allocated to any manufacturer |
| Serial numbers | `SYN-XXXXXXXX` | Explicit `SYN-` prefix |
| Asset tags | `LT-100xxx`, `MON-2xxxxx`, `TD-000xx` | Non-production ranges |
| Employee IDs | `EMP-0000` | Non-production range |
| Procurement refs | `PO-SYN-…`, `SYN-DOC-…` | Explicit synthetic marker |
| Vendors | `Example Vendor Co.`, `Sample Supplier Ltd.` | Placeholder companies |
| Hardware models | `ExampleBook`, `ExamplePhone`, `ExampleView` | Invented product lines |
| Cost fields | Random within a fixed band | Derived from the seeded PRNG |
| Date of birth / TIN | Left empty | Not generated at all |

## Using them in the app

In the sidebar under **Data sources**, use **Load demo data**. That button fetches
these four files over `fetch()`, so it needs the app to be served over HTTP
rather than opened as a `file://` URL. See the repository README for the
one-line static server command.
